## Meet Marc & Charles

In late 2021, Charles and Marc met through a technical question posted in the [French Startup Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/frenchstartups). Charles, who had built several successful e-commerce brands and managed [France's largest travel newsletter](https://lesvoyagespaschersdeleo.fr/), was looking for technical expertise.

Marc, having recently sold his [recruitment startup](https://amazing.dev/), was immediately intrigued by Charles' vision for e-commerce solutions. Their complementary skills in marketing and development proved to be the perfect match.

Today, they continue to personally develop and support their suite of apps, maintaining the high standards and attention to detail that has earned them the trust of thousands of merchants worldwide.

![Marc and Charles](https://penida.io/assets/467a019e77-DALLE-2025-01-05-13.27.59-Two-men-in-Pixar-style--1200.webp)
